LETTER AGREEMENT - HOSPITAL SERVICES RATES AND
TERMS
Date: 14th day of August, 2021
This letter agreement sets out how Evergreen Health Partners (the Plan) will reimburse Ridgeway
Rehabilitation Institute (the Provider) for covered services given to the Plan's members. It replaces the
parties' earlier arrangement dated August 14, 2018, under which clean claims were paid within 35 days and
acute inpatient care was paid at $3,175 per day. Those earlier terms no longer apply.
Rates. Starting on 14th day of August, 2021, the Plan will pay a flat per diem of $3,375 for each day of acute
medical/surgical inpatient care, and one hundred twenty-five (125) percent of the Medicare fee schedule for
general outpatient services. Behavioral health inpatient stays are paid at $3,775 per day, and emergency
department visits at 115 percent of Medicare.

Payment and filing. The Plan will pay each clean claim within twenty (20) days after it receives the claim.
The Provider must send claims no later than one hundred twenty (120) days after the date of service. A
denied claim may be appealed within 150 days.
Credentialing. The Plan will finish credentialing the Provider's clinicians within thirty (30) days of getting a
complete application.
Duration. This letter agreement begins on the 14th day of August, 2021, runs for three years, and ends on the
13th day of August, 2024. It will not roll over; a new signed agreement is needed to continue after that date.
Either side may end it early, without cause, by giving one hundred eighty (180) days written notice.

Law. This letter agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.
Insurance and records. The Provider will carry professional liability cover of $2,000,000 per occurrence and
keep records for 7 years.
Please countersign below to confirm that this reflects our agreement.
